check.mcp_script:
#!/bin/sh
while IFS= read -r line; do
  id=$(printf '%s' "$line" | sed -n 's/.*"id":\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
  case "$line" in
    *'"method":"tools/list"'*) printf '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":%s,"result":{"resultType":"complete","tools":[{"name":"answer","inputSchema":{"type":"object"}}]}}\n' "$id" ;;
  esac
done
